name: ship-check
description: Three independent read-only checks in parallel (behaviour, accessibility and design, contest rules), merged into one report. Run before every deploy and before submitting.

branches.prompt: Review packages/ and apps/ for behavioural bugs against .kiro/specs/*/requirements.md: determinism, damaged frames, collisions, ledger correctness, attention and missed-item rules in Night Desk, reload recovery, and the independence of the two apps from each other. Do not edit files. Cite file and line.

Run the checks, then read every interface file in apps/, site/ and the kit's replay entry against .kiro/steering/design-language.md (the 'Never' list is binding) and the accessibility requirements in the night-desk, consoles and seance-replay specs. Write findings to reports/workflow/experience.md.

Read the 'Submission checklist' in docs/PLAN.md. Check each item against the repository (licence file, .kiro at root and not ignored, two separate application folders, README run instructions, no secrets, font and voice licences recorded, no third-party trademarks or copyrighted audio). Do not edit source. Write a pass/fail table with evidence to reports/workflow/rules.md.

steps.prompt:
Merge the three check results (the behaviour review output below, reports/workflow/experience.md and reports/workflow/rules.md) into reports/workflow/ship-check.md: blocking issues first, then the rest, deduplicated, each with file and line.

{{behaviour.output}}
